name: brineborn_cutthroat_flash_cast_then_counter_per_spell_on_opponents_turn
notes: Printed: 'Flash / Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' On the opponent's turn you flash the Cutthroat in (its own cast does not trigger it: it was not on the battlefield), then cast Raise the Alarm: exactly one +1/+1 counter, 2/1 -> 3/2.
